mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month expansion in nonfarm payrolls exceeding 100k monthly growth signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with PAYEMS growth >100k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) decline exceeding 5% from prior month signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (HOUST decline >5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) decline exceeding 0.5% from prior month indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (INDPRO decline >0.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 3% each from prior month indicate broad consumer demand deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline >3%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) >0.25% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) >0.3% from prior month signal aggressive monetary tightening, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% and CPIAUCSL rises >0.3%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a further decline in unemployment rate signals tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE decline, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 105.0), a further decline in industrial production signals deteriorating economic conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with INDPRO < 105.0 and INDPRO decline, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
